# STF-2 verification plan (generated by verify_plan.py)

96 values the proofs rest on that are assumed or typical. Each numeric one was moved -20% and +20% and every proof (model, oven control, PLC, safety) re-run. Re-run the proofs with the measured value; the design is released when they pass with it.
